scripts.deploy:local: npx hardhat ignition deploy --network localhost ignition/modules/SonyBankStableCoin.ts
scripts.graph:compile: cd subgraph && yq -i e '.dataSources[].network = "localhost" | (.templates[]?.network = "localhost")' subgraph.yaml && npx graph codegen subgraph.yaml && npx graph build subgraph.yaml
scripts.graph:deploy:local: npm run graph:compile && npx graph create --node http://localhost:8020 sbsc && cd subgraph && npx graph deploy --version-label v1.0.$(date +%s) --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001/api/v0 sbsc subgraph.yaml && echo 'Check it out on http://localhost:8000/subgraphs/name/sbsc/'
scripts.forge:coverageReport: forge coverage --report lcov && mkdir coverage &&  lcov-viewer lcov -o ./coverage ./lcov.info
